Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Stafford for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from the Candy Cane Hunt at Government Island and Cookies with Santa (December 10 and 12) to the Stafford Christmas Parade (December 19), with the Christmas Model Train Show (December 12 and 13) and Together We Sing in between. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Stafford

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Stafford
  • 2 free events, the Stafford Christmas Parade and Cookies with Santa
  • Meet Santa: Cookies with Santa at Jeff Rouse Swim and Sport Center (December 10) and the Christmas Model Train Show (December 12 and 13)
  • Parades: Stafford Christmas Parade (December 19)
  • Outdoors: Candy Cane Hunt at Government Island (December 12, ages 3 to 15)
  • Trains: Christmas Model Train Show (December 12 and 13)
  • Concerts: Together We Sing with the Stafford Choral Society
  • Season: December 10 to December 19

Planning a bigger day out? Stafford families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Fredericksburg, which covers the VRE Santa Train, the Christmas Parade and Pictures with Santa.
